title: Herbed Parmesan Dutch Baby
changes_from_base: Savoury: an 8-egg batter with black pepper, thyme and chives is poured into nutty browned butter and baked under a layer of grated Parmesan and flaky salt; served with lemon (and chilli sauce if you like) instead of berries.
summary: A savoury herb-fragrant puffed pancake topped with nutty brown butter and a generous shower of Parmesan cheese.
equipment: 30 cm cast-iron or ovenproof frying pan

ingredients.item: fine sea salt or table salt
lemon, cut into wedges, to serve

steps.title: Preheat
steps.text: Set a 30 cm cast-iron or ovenproof frying pan in a 220 °C (200 °C fan) oven whilst it heats.

steps.title: Mix Flour
steps.text: Mix 134 g plain flour, ½ tsp fine salt and ½ tsp coarsely ground black pepper in a large bowl.

steps.title: Combine Batter
steps.text: Whisk 8 large eggs and 170 ml whole milk together in a separate bowl, then whisk this into the flour just until combined; stir in 2 tbsp finely chopped fresh thyme and 2 tbsp finely chopped chives.

steps.title: Brown Butter
steps.text: Melt 57 g unsalted butter in the hot pan over medium-high heat and continue cooking 5-7 minutes until it smells nutty and turns brown, swirling to coat; pour in the batter, scatter 85 g finely grated Parmesan and ½ tsp flaky sea salt over and bake 20-25 minutes until puffed and golden.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Slice the warm pancake and serve straight away with lemon wedges and chilli sauce if you like.

tips: Brown the butter thoroughly for a nuttier, deeper flavour before adding the batter
Whisk the egg mixture into the flour gently to prevent overdeveloping gluten
Serve at once with lemon wedges for brightness and acidity
storage: Serve hot straight from the oven. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
